selected.item: Thinking Machines Lab released Inkling 2 Mini on November 20, 2026, as an open-weight general-purpose multimodal model. The official Hugging Face model card states 'Date of release: November 20, 2026' and Apache 2.0. It is the lab's first looped transformer: a 24-layer decoder-only MoE transformer whose middle 12 layers run three times with shared weights, giving 48 layer applications per token from 24 layers of weights. It has 26.4B total parameters and 3.4B active per token (5.4B effective active with the three loop passes), a 1M-token context window, text and image inputs and text outputs, and is distributed as a single ~20GB checkpoint in NVFP4/MXFP8. The card says it can run on 1x NVIDIA DGX Spark and on Apple silicon devices with 32GB or more memory. Vendor-reported evaluations include an Artificial Analysis Index of 20.1 and 79.2% on SWE-Bench Verified.
selected.note: The official model card states the release date as November 20, 2026; no announcement time is asserted. Performance figures are the vendor's own reported numbers.

selected.item: Tencent launched Hy4-flash on November 16, 2026, on its official Hunyuan research site (hy.tencent.ai), and released the open weights (Hy4-flash, Hy4-flash-FP8 and Hy4-flash-base) on November 18 on Hugging Face, ModelScope and GitCode. Per Tencent's official Hugging Face model card, Hy4-flash is the most cost-effective Hy model to date: 220B total parameters (including 64B Engram parameters) with about 12B active per token, native text and image inputs, text outputs, and a 1M-token context window. The announcement page lists API prices of 0.5 yuan per 1M input tokens, 2 yuan per 1M output tokens and 0.02 yuan per 1M cached-input tokens. On Tencent's internal WorkIndex benchmark it scores 42.1, slightly above Hy4 preview (39.7), with an average cost per task of 1/13 of Hy4 preview and 1/20 of Hy4. Tencent recommends it for everyday productivity work and Hy4 for complex work such as long-horizon software engineering. It is distinct from the flagship Hy4 (November 4, 2026).
selected.note: The Hugging Face model card itself carries no date line, so the November 16 launch date is recorded from Tencent's official announcement page as reported by multiple independent secondary sources (TechNode, explainx, 4sapi, Longbridge/Zhitong, ai-oriens, web-observer), corroborated by the November 16 OpenRouter listing and first-day usage reports. The November 18 open-weight release date is from the same secondary reports. Prices are from the announcement page as reported. Performance figures are the vendor's own claims.

selected.item: SenseTime officially released SenseNova Loop-9B on November 17, 2026, per its official release page dated 2026/11/17. It is an open-weight multimodal model of approximately 9B parameters whose 32 decoder layers are looped: layers 4-27 run twice with shared weights, giving 56 decoder-layer executions per forward pass (about 14.6B inference-equivalent parameters). It accepts text and image inputs, produces text outputs, and supports a context length of up to 512K tokens. The official 4-bit AWQ quantized weights occupy about 4.9GB, and deployment GPU memory can be under 10GB. SenseTime positions its performance as comparable to 27B-class models, reporting NL2Repo 41.36 (Qwen3.8-27B: 44.60) and AIDABench 65.31 (Qwen3.8-27B: 65.01). It is the official release following the October 31 Preview version.
selected.note: The official SenseTime release page carries the 2026/11/17 date only, so no announcement time is asserted. Performance figures are the vendor's own reported numbers. No license is asserted from the SenseTime page.
